title: Wrong-Way Sedan Beyond a Blind Crest acceptance rubric
originalIntent: Ego climbs a narrow curved overpass at 40 km/h. A wrong-way sedan becomes apparent beyond a blind crest while a correct-direction bus blocks the opposing lane and a motorcycle follows. Ego and the wrong-way car brake rather than passing or reversing; ego stays in its lane, edges right without touching the parapet, reaches below 5 km/h before body separation falls below 8 metres, and holds position collision-free with a positive follower gap.

criteria.description: Ego is below 5 km/h before shape separation to the wrong-way sedan falls below 8 metres.
criteria.reason: The typed evaluator cannot combine a time-varying pair clearance threshold with actor speed; the scenario-specific gate checks the engine minimum-clearance timestamp and ego speed from the same trace.

criteria.description: Ego preserves at least 0.4 metres clearance from every collidable parapet segment.
criteria.reason: The typed evaluator has no actor-to-prop clearance criterion; the scenario-specific gate computes oriented-rectangle clearance from the actor track and trace prop metadata.

criteria.description: The moving bus is alongside on a native opposing lane during the 8–12 second conflict and ego never enters that lane.
criteria.reason: The typed evaluator cannot combine relative distance, actor motion, and distinct-lane occupancy; the scenario-specific gate checks all three from the trace and materialized route.
